# Abeta Dynamic Layout Engine

> Complete LLM engineering reference for `github.com/abeta-dev/layout-engine` (`Abeta-dev/layout-engine`, `v0.3.0`): a Go 1.26.0, multi-tenant, rule-driven Server-Driven UI (SDUI) Layout Engine & Visual Layout Studio emitting 1:1 wire-compatible `v1` SDUI contracts from `github.com/abeta-dev/kmp/bff@v0.5.0` wrapped in `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs@v0.4.0` envelopes.

---

## 1. Architecture & Dependency Rule

`Abeta-dev/layout-engine` enforces strict **Clean Architecture** (the Uncle Bob Dependency Rule). Dependencies point strictly inward toward `internal/domain`:

```text
cmd/layout-engine
  -> internal/handler      (Gin router, Runtime/Studio handlers, embedded /studio SPA, OpenAPI/Scalar, /llms.txt, Brotli/gzip, ETag)
  -> internal/usecase      (ResolveService, StudioService, ActionService)
  -> internal/domain       (Pure entities, value objects, sentinel errors, Store & Engine ports)
  <- internal/engine       (RuleEvaluator, ScheduleWindow matcher, SlottingEngine, LayoutValidator, DiffEngine)
  <- pkg/transformer       (Open/Closed WidgetTransformer Registry, PageComposer, props merge & {{placeholder}} interpolation)
  <- internal/infra/persistence (Dual SQLite + PostgreSQL 17 SQLStore, embedded migrations, 7-vertical seeder)
```

### Automated Boundary Guard
`internal/domain/arch_test.go` parses AST imports on every `go test ./...` run and fails if any non-test file in `internal/domain` or `internal/engine` imports:
- `github.com/gin-gonic/gin`, `net/http`
- `database/sql`, `modernc.org/sqlite`, `github.com/jackc/pgx`
- `internal/infra`, `internal/handler`

### Shared Abeta Ecosystem Dependencies (`go.mod`)
- `github.com/abeta-dev/kmp/bff v0.5.0` — Canonical Go `v1` SDUI wire contracts under `pkg/sdui/{actions,atoms,snippets,theming}` (28 Wire Atoms / 30 UI Atoms incl. `CountdownAtom` and 12 extended fintech/commerce atoms, 21 SnippetTypes incl. `composed_block` Atomic Snippet Molding Engine with 29 `ComposedNodeKind`s, 18 ActionTypes, 7 ambient `MotionLoopEffect`s, adaptive layouts, floating cart with free-delivery threshold nudges, motion specs, theming catalog).
- `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs v0.4.0` — Production Go middleware & primitives (`ginmw` response envelopes/CORS/telemetry/metrics/rate-limit/JWT auth, `apperror`, `health`, `logger`, `env`, `shutdown`).
- `modernc.org/sqlite v1.62.0` — Pure-Go SQLite (`CGO_ENABLED=0`) for zero-config local/edge operation.
- `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 v5.11.0` — PostgreSQL 17 production driver (`pgx/v5/stdlib`).
- `github.com/andybalholm/brotli v1.3.0` — Negotiated Brotli (`br`) compression alongside gzip.

### Dual Persistence & 10 Domain Store Ports
`internal/infra/persistence.SQLStore` implements `domain.Store` identically across both dialects using embedded migrations (`migrations/sqlite/0001_initial_schema.sql` and `migrations/postgres/0001_initial_schema.sql`):
- **SQLite Default (Zero-Config)**: `DB_DIALECT=sqlite`, `DB_DSN=file:layout-engine.db?_pragma=busy_timeout(5000)&_pragma=journal_mode(WAL)` with fixed-width UTC RFC3339Nano timestamps for exact lexical chronology.
- **PostgreSQL 17 Production**: `DB_DIALECT=postgres`, `DB_DSN=postgres://layout:layout@postgres:5432/layout_engine?sslmode=disable` (wired in `docker-compose.yaml`).
- **Composed `domain.Store` Ports**: `TenantStore`, `TemplateStore`, `WidgetStore`, `LayoutStore`, `RuleStore`, `SlottingStore`, `SnapshotStore`, `FallbackStore`, `ConfigStore` (`SplashConfig`, `TokenOverride`), and `ChangeLogStore`.

---

## 2. Wire Contract Parity (`github.com/abeta-dev/kmp/bff@v0.5.0`)

All `/api/v1/*` JSON responses are wrapped in `go-libs/ginmw` envelopes (`{ "success": true, "data": ..., "meta": { "request_id": "..." } }`), making the Layout Engine an immediate drop-in BFF for `Abeta-dev/kmp` clients (`--bff-url=http://localhost:8090`).

### All 21 Canonical KMP `v1` `SnippetTypes`
`pkg/transformer.NewDefaultRegistry()` registers built-in transformers for all 21 canonical snippet types. Callers may register custom 22nd+ snippet transformers via `Registry.Register(WidgetTransformer)` without modifying built-ins.

| # | `snippet_type` | Category | Role & Key Props |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | `header_v1` | Content | Page/section header with title, subtitle, leading/trailing icons, badge tag, and click action. |
| 2 | `banner_v1` | Promo | Hero or promotional banner with title, subtitle, image, CTA button, tag, and gradient/surface style. |
| 3 | `metric_card` | KPI | Single KPI metric with label, formatted value, delta indicator, trend icon, and tap action. |
| 4 | `card_v1` | Content | Versatile media/info card with image, title, subtitle, badges, metadata, and primary/secondary actions. |
| 5 | `action_row` | Navigation | Horizontal interactive row with leading icon/avatar, title, subtitle, trailing tag/chevron, and action. |
| 6 | `form_v1` | Input | Schema-driven form with validated fields (`text`, `switch`, `checkbox`, `slider`), submit button, and `call_api` action. |
| 7 | `empty_state` | State | Centered fallback/empty illustration with icon, title, description, and recovery CTA button. |
| 8 | `divider` | Chrome | Structural horizontal rule with optional thickness and color token. |
| 9 | `spacer` | Chrome | Explicit vertical spacing block (`height_dp`). |
| 10 | `carousel` | Container | Horizontal scrolling strip referencing `child_widget_ids` (or inline envelopes) with `item_width_by_width` responsive sizing. |
| 11 | `grid` | Container | Multi-column layout (`columns > 0`, optional `columns_by_width`) referencing `child_widget_ids` or inline envelopes. |
| 12 | `tabs` | Container | Tabbed sections where each tab defines `id`, `title`, and nested child widgets/envelopes. |
| 13 | `accordion` | Container | Collapsible expandable sections with titles and nested child widgets/envelopes. |
| 14 | `product_card` | Commerce | Merchandising SKU card with image, title, unit/variant, price/MRP, discount tag, and interactive quantity `stepper` (drives `FloatingCartSpec`). |
| 15 | `search_bar` | Interactive | Instant/submit search bar with placeholder, leading/trailing icons, suggestions/query action (`search_bar`). |
| 16 | `chip_group` | Interactive | Selectable filter/category chip strip (single- or multi-select) emitting state/API actions (`chip_group`). |
| 17 | `swipe_deck` | Interactive | Interactive card stack supporting right/left/super swipe and undo actions (`swipe_deck`). |
| 18 | `nudge_bar` | Nudges | Dismissible urgency, threshold, or flash-drop strip with animated `badge`, live `CountdownAtom`, optional `progress` (`0..1`), CTA, and dismiss trigger (`nudge_bar`). |
| 19 | `marquee_strip` | Nudges | Continuously scrolling horizontal announcement/offer ticker (`items`, `velocity_dp_per_sec` default `48`, `separator` default `"•"`) (`marquee_strip`). |
| 20 | `order_tracker` | Live Tracking | Animated multi-stage live order milestone card (`order_code`, `headline`, `eta_countdown`, `eta_badge`, `rider_name`/`rider_caption`, `steps`, primary/secondary CTAs) (`order_tracker`). |
| 21 | `composed_block` | Atomic Molding | Server-molded recursive atomic tree (`block_id`, `recipe_name`, `root`) supporting all **29 `ComposedNodeKind`s** (`column`, `row`, `box`, `card`, `flow_row`, `text`, `button`, `tag`, `icon`, `image`, `avatar`, `progress`, `divider`, `spacer`, `stepper`, `countdown`, `rolling_counter`, `radio_group`, `select`, `otp_input`, `chip`, `segmented_control`, `rating`, `price`, `badge`, `alert_banner`, `stat_tile`, `key_value_row`, `qr_code`) with `maxDepth <= 6`—inventing new cards server-side with zero client releases (`composed_block`). |

### 28 Wire Atoms / 30 UI Atoms, 7 Ambient `MotionLoopEffect`s, 18 Action Types & Page Chrome
- **28 Wire Atoms (`pkg/sdui/atoms`) / 30 KMP UI Atoms**: Text, Icon, Tag, Button, Image, TextField, Divider, Spacer, Progress, Switch, Checkbox, Slider, Avatar, Skeleton, Stepper (`StepperAtom`), Countdown (`CountdownAtom`), plus 12 extended atoms (`RadioGroupAtom`, `SelectAtom`, `OtpInputAtom`, `ChipAtom`, `SegmentedControlAtom`, `RatingAtom`, `PriceAtom`, `BadgeAtom`, `AlertBannerAtom`, `StatTileAtom`, `KeyValueRowAtom`, `QrCodeAtom`) + `MotionSpec`, `LayoutConfig`, `TrackingMeta` (rendered alongside `UiSurfaceCard` & `UiRollingCounter` for 30 KMP UI atoms).
- **7 Ambient `MotionLoopEffect`s (`MotionSpec.LoopEffect`)**: `pulse`, `shimmer`, `wiggle`, `float`, `heartbeat`, `glow_ring`, `marquee` (alongside `none`, honoring client reduced-motion settings).
- **18 Action Types (`pkg/sdui/actions`)**: `navigate`, `back_press`, `open_dialog`, `dismiss_overlay`, `show_toast`, `call_api`, `save_state`, `delete_state`, `track_event`, `refresh_page`, `copy_to_clipboard`, `update_snippets`, `batch`, `trigger_feedback`, `open_url`, `share`, `request_permission`, `biometric_auth`. Handled server-side by `ActionService` on `POST /api/v1/actions/execute` and `POST /api/v1/orders/express`.
- **Page Chrome (`LayoutPageConfig` -> `snippets.PageResponse`)**: `ToolbarSpec`, `BottomBarSpec`, `FloatingCartSpec` (with free-delivery threshold nudge fields `free_delivery_threshold_cents`, `nudge_prefix`, `unlocked_label`), `AdaptivePageSpec` (`layout_mode`: `single_column`, `centered`, `split_pane`; `max_width_dp`; `secondary_snippet_ids`), `PaginationSpec`, `PullToRefresh`, `PageActions`, and auto-populated `page_view` `TrackingMeta`.

## 3. Targeting Rules, Context Extraction & UTC Schedules

### `RequestContext` Extraction (Query Param -> HTTP Header -> Default)

| Context Field | Query Parameter | HTTP Header | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tenant_slug` | `tenant` | `X-Tenant-ID` | `abeta-fresh` |
| `platform` | `platform` | `X-Platform` | `desktop` |
| `app_version` | `app_version` | `X-App-Version` | `1.0.0` |
| `city` | `city` | `X-City` | `Bengaluru` |
| `zone` | `zone` | `X-Zone` | `koramangala-01` |
| `segment` | `segment` | `X-User-Segment` | `standard` |
| `user_id` | `user_id` | `X-User-ID` | `guest` |
| `window_class` | `window_class` | `X-Window-Class` | `compact` |
| `dark_mode` | `dark_mode` | `X-Dark-Mode` | `false` |
| `now` | `at` (RFC3339 UTC) | — | Current UTC time |
| `attributes.<k>` | `attr_<k>=<value>` | — | `{}` |

### All 13 Targeting Rule Operators (`internal/engine/rule_evaluator.go`)
Each `TargetingRule` evaluates `enabled`, then optional `schedule` (UTC), then `conditions` combined via `match_mode` (`"all"` AND default, or `"any"` OR). Empty `conditions` match when enabled and inside schedule.

| # | Operator | Semantics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | `eq` | Case-insensitive string, boolean, or numeric equality. |
| 2 | `neq` | Negation of `eq` (missing fields compare as empty string). |
| 3 | `in` | Membership in a JSON array (`[]string`, `[]any`, `[]int`, `[]float64`) or comma-separated string. |
| 4 | `not_in` | Negation of `in`. |
| 5 | `gt` | Floating-point strictly greater than (`actual > value`). |
| 6 | `gte` | Floating-point greater than or equal (`actual >= value`). |
| 7 | `lt` | Floating-point strictly less than (`actual < value`). |
| 8 | `lte` | Floating-point less than or equal (`actual <= value`). |
| 9 | `semver_gte` | SemVer 2.0 comparison (`actual >= value`, handles optional `v` prefix and prerelease precedence). |
| 10 | `semver_lt` | SemVer 2.0 comparison (`actual < value`). |
| 11 | `contains` | Case-insensitive substring match (`strings.Contains`). |
| 12 | `regex` | Go RE2 regular expression match (`regexp.Compile`). |
| 13 | `bucket_pct` | Deterministic **FNV-1a 32-bit** percentage rollout: `fnv32a(ruleKey + ":" + seed) % 100 < pct` (uses field value, falling back to `user_id`, then `tenant:platform:city:zone:segment`). |

### UTC Schedule Windows (`domain.ScheduleWindow`)
Applicable to `TargetingRule`, `LayoutSlot`, `SlottingRule`, and `SplashConfig`:
- `start_at` / `end_at`: inclusive UTC RFC3339 bounds.
- `days_of_week`: slice of UTC weekdays (`0 = Sunday` .. `6 = Saturday`).
- `start_hour_utc` / `end_hour_utc`: half-open `[start, end)` when `start != end`, supporting overnight wrap-around (e.g., `22..4` matches hours `22, 23, 0, 1, 2, 3`), or exact single-hour match when `start == end`.

---

## 4. Dynamic Slotting Engine & Placeholder Interpolation

### Dynamic Slotting (`internal/engine/slotting_engine.go`)
`DefaultSlottingEngine.Apply` mutates a published layout's base slot list dynamically at runtime without republishing the layout:
1. Base slots are stably sorted by `position` ascending.
2. Enabled `SlottingRule` entries for `layout_slug` are sorted by `priority` **descending** (tie-broken by `id` ascending).
3. Each rule verifies its `ScheduleWindow` and optional `rule_id`. Higher-priority rules retain ownership of a `widget_id`; widgets already locked in a `pinned: true` base slot are never duplicated.
4. Four supported `SlottingAction` operations:
   - `prepend` — inserts the widget at index `0`.
   - `append` — appends the widget to the end of the slot list.
   - `insert` — inserts at `target_position` (clamped to `[0, len]`).
   - `replace` — replaces the slot at `target_position`; if that slot has **`pinned: true`**, the pinned slot stays intact and the injected widget is inserted immediately after it (`idx + 1`).
5. Prior unpinned duplicates of an injected `widget_id` are removed, final deduplication ensures each `widget_id` renders at most once, and all slots are re-indexed sequentially `0..N-1`.

### Deep-Merge Overrides & `{{placeholder}}` Interpolation (`pkg/transformer/props.go`)
Before transforming each widget, `MergeAndInterpolateProps` deep-merges `slot.overrides` over `widget.props` without mutating either map, then recursively interpolates placeholders across all string leaves, page title, toolbar, bottom bar, floating cart, pagination, pull-to-refresh, and page actions:
- Built-in tokens: `{{city}}`, `{{zone}}`, `{{segment}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{app_version}}`, `{{tenant}}`, `{{tenant_slug}}`, `{{window_class}}`, `{{user_id}}`.
- Custom attributes (`?attr_<k>=<v>`): `{{<k>}}` or `{{attr.<k>}}` (case-insensitive fallback).
- Unknown placeholders are preserved intact.

---

## 5. Governance: Validation, Immutable Snapshots, Rollbacks & Safe Fallbacks

Runtime endpoints **never** serve unvalidated drafts. Every layout follows a strict governed lifecycle:

1. **Draft Editing (`PUT /api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug`)**: Updates `Layout` draft metadata, `page_config`, and `slots` while recording a `ChangeLogEntry`.
2. **Validation (`POST /api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/validate`)**: `DefaultLayoutValidator` enforces URL-safe slug regex `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$`, non-empty title, valid `adaptive_layout.layout_mode` (`single_column`/`centered`/`split_pane`), unique `slot_id`s, valid active widgets across all 21 KMP `SnippetTypes`, positive `columns` on `grid`, non-empty tab `id`/`title`, valid inline container envelopes, `nudge_bar` non-empty `title` & optional `progress` in `0..1`, `marquee_strip` non-empty item `text`, `order_tracker` `headline` & `steps`, **`composed_block`** valid `root` across all **29 `ComposedNodeKind`s** with **`maxDepth <= 6`**, and recursive container **cycle detection (`cycle_detected`)**.
3. **Immutable Snapshot Publishing (`POST /api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/publish`)**: Re-validates the draft, increments `published_version`, freezes `PageConfig`, `Slots`, and `ResolvedWidgets` into an immutable `PublishedSnapshot`, and writes field-level JSON diffs (`[]DiffItem` with `add`/`remove`/`replace`) to `ChangeLogEntry` tagged with `X-Studio-Actor` (default `studio-admin`).
4. **One-Call Rollback (`POST /api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/rollback`)**: Restores any historical snapshot version `vK` as a brand-new immutable active version `vN+1` while preserving complete version history and audit diffs.
5. **Guaranteed Automatic Fallback (`POST /api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/fallback`)**: Promotes the latest published snapshot into a pre-validated `FallbackLayout`. If runtime snapshot loading or page composition fails, `ResolveService` automatically serves the `FallbackLayout`, attaches `X-Layout-Fallback: true`, and sets `ResolutionTrace.used_fallback = true` with `fallback_reason`.
6. **Live Context Simulation & Trace**: `POST /api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/preview` (`{"draft": true|false, "context": {...}}`) and `GET /api/v1/pages/:slug?include_trace=true` return `{ "page": PageResponse, "trace": ResolutionTrace }` detailing `snapshot_version`, `matched_rule_ids`, `applied_slotting_ids`, `skipped_slot_ids`, `used_fallback`, and `duration_ms`.

---

## 6. Seven Pre-Seeded Multi-Tenant Vertical Workspaces

On first boot (`SEED_DEFAULT_DATA=true`), `persistence.SeedDefaultData` idempotently provisions **7 isolated vertical workspaces**, each seeded with all **21 KMP `v1` widget templates** (28 wire atoms, 29 `ComposedNodeKind`s), curated widgets, targeting rules, slotting rules, immutable `v1` snapshots, guaranteed fallbacks, splash configs, and design token overrides. Select any tenant via `?tenant=<slug>` or `X-Tenant-ID: <slug>`.

| Tenant Slug | Vertical Workspace | Published Dynamic Layouts | Rules, Slotting & Action Highlights |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`abeta-fresh`** *(default)* | Abeta Fresh — Quick-Commerce Grocery | `store-home`, `fresh-home`, `flash-sale`, `home`, `catalog`, `form-demo`, `containers`, `watch-status` | 5 targeting rules (VIP, Bengaluru, morning UTC window, mobile SemVer, 50% FNV-1a rollout); VIP & morning slotting; `fresh-home` enriched with `marquee_strip`, Flash Drop `nudge_bar` (w/ `CountdownAtom`), molded `composed_block` Loyalty Stamp card & `FloatingCartSpec` (`free_delivery_threshold_cents: 1500`) -> `/api/v1/fresh/orders/express`; Watch glance screen. |
| **`abeta-bites`** | Abeta Bites — Food Delivery & Dining | `bites-home`, `bites-restaurant`, `bites-order-track` | Dining `search_bar` + `chip_group`, `mumbai_or_vip` (`city == "Mumbai"` OR `segment == "vip"`) & `dinner_rush_window` slotting, menu `product_card` grid with `FloatingCartSpec` -> `/api/v1/bites/orders`, animated 4-step `order_tracker` (`#BTS-4091`). |
| **`abeta-pulse`** | Abeta Pulse — Events, Movies & Dining Tickets | `pulse-home`, `pulse-event-detail` | Concerts/IMAX/comedy `search_bar` + `chip_group`, `weekend_spotlight` (Fri–Sun UTC) slotting banner, event detail & seat-tier booking (`/api/v1/pulse/bookings`). |
| **`abeta-mart`** | Abeta Mart — Multi-Category Marketplace | `mart-home`, `mart-product-detail` | Category `search_bar` + `chip_group`, `mart_vip_segment` VIP lightning deal slotting, Lightning Deals `carousel`, responsive `grid`, and specs `accordion`. |
| **`abeta-spark`** | Abeta Spark — Swipe Discovery & Matches | `spark-deck`, `spark-matches` | City `header_v1`, discovery `chip_group`, `evening_boost_window` slotting, 4-profile interactive `swipe_deck` (`/api/v1/spark/swipe` + undo), and match `action_row` widgets. |
| **`abeta-trade`** | Abeta Trade — B2B Wholesale & RFQ Sourcing | `trade-home`, `trade-supplier` | GST-verified wholesale `search_bar` + `chip_group`, `enterprise_buyers` (`segment in ["enterprise", "vip"]`) procurement slotting, MOQ supplier cards, validated RFQ `form_v1` (`/api/v1/trade/rfq`). |
| **`abeta-pay`** | Abeta Pay — Instant Payments & Smart Cards | `pay-home`, `pay-transfer`, `pay-cards`, `pay-receipt` | Zero-fee P2P wallet, `metal_or_vip` (`segment in ["vip", "metal"]`) & `metro_instant_clearing` rules, Metal Concierge slotting on `pay-home`, molded `composed_block` cards showcasing all 12 extended atoms (`QrCode`, `OtpInput`, `RadioGroup`, `SegmentedControl`, `StatTile`, `KeyValueRow`, `AlertBanner`, `Badge`, `Price`, `Rating`, `Select`, `Chip`), biometric transfer auth, smart card switches/slider, and `#PAY-3081` 4-step settlement `order_tracker` with celebration trigger. |

## 7. Complete HTTP API Reference

### Studio UI, Docs, LLMs & Observability

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/studio` | Embedded zero-build Visual Layout Studio SPA (`index.html`, `/studio/app.css`, `/studio/app.js`). |
| `GET` | `/openapi.json` | Live OpenAPI 3.1 JSON specification. |
| `GET` | `/docs` | Interactive Scalar API Reference UI backed by `/openapi.json`. |
| `GET` | `/llms.txt` | Plain-text `llmstxt.org` repository index (`text/plain; charset=utf-8`). |
| `GET` | `/llms-full.txt` | Plain-text full LLM reference (`text/plain; charset=utf-8`). |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe (`go-libs/health`). |
| `GET` | `/readyz` | Readiness probe verifying `persistence_store` ping. |
| `GET` | `/metrics` | RED HTTP telemetry metrics (`go-libs/ginmw`). |

### Runtime KMP-Compatible SDUI API (`ginmw.Envelope`)

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/screens` | List published screen slugs for the active tenant (`ETag` enabled). |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/screens/:screenId` | Drop-in KMP `PageResponse` resolver; sets `X-Layout-Version` and optional `X-Layout-Fallback: true` (`ETag` enabled). |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/pages/:slug` | Resolve dynamic `PageResponse`; add `?include_trace=true` to return `{ page, trace }` (`ETag` enabled). |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/config/splash` | Resolve highest-priority rule- and schedule-targeted `SplashConfig` (`ETag` enabled). |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/catalog/tokens` | Resolve base `v1` design token catalog merged with matching `TokenOverride`s (`ETag` enabled). |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/actions/execute` | Execute KMP `ActionTrigger` payloads across all 18 `v1` action types and return follow-up actions. |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/orders/express` | Quick-commerce express order checkout returning celebration (`trigger_feedback`) and confirmation (`show_toast`) follow-ups. |

### Studio Authoring & Governance API (`/api/v1/studio/*`)
Supports `X-Studio-Actor` audit attribution and optional fail-closed JWT middleware when `AUTH_REQUIRED=true`.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET`, `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/tenants` | List or create/update multi-tenant workspaces. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/studio/templates` | List all 21 canonical KMP `v1` widget templates for the tenant. |
| `GET`, `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/widgets` | List or upsert reusable CMS widgets. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/studio/widgets/:id` | Delete a widget by ID. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts` | List all draft/published layouts for the tenant. |
| `GET`, `PUT` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug` | Fetch or upsert a layout draft (`page_config`, `slots`, `title`). |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/validate` | Validate layout draft (schema, 21 snippet types, `composed_block` depth `<= 6`, container cycle detection). |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/publish` | Validate and publish an immutable versioned `PublishedSnapshot` + changelog diff. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/versions` | List all historical `PublishedSnapshot` versions. |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/rollback` | Roll back layout to a historical snapshot version (`{"version": K}`). |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/fallback` | Promote the latest published snapshot to the guaranteed `FallbackLayout`. |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/layouts/:slug/preview` | Simulate draft or published resolution with custom `RequestContext` and `ResolutionTrace`. |
| `GET`, `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/rules` | List or upsert targeting rules (`conditions`, `match_mode`, `schedule`). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/studio/rules/:id` | Delete a targeting rule by ID. |
| `GET`, `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/slotting` | List or upsert dynamic slotting rules (`prepend`/`append`/`insert`/`replace`). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/studio/slotting/:id` | Delete a dynamic slotting rule by ID. |
| `GET`, `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/splash` | List or upsert rule-targeted launch splash configurations. |
| `GET`, `POST` | `/api/v1/studio/tokens` | List or upsert rule-targeted runtime design token overrides. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/studio/changelog` | List immutable audit log entries with actor, summary, and field-level JSON diffs. |

## 8. Configuration, Transport & Quickstart Commands

### Key Environment Variables (`cmd/layout-engine/main.go`)
- `PORT` (default `8090`), `HTTP_ADDR` (default `:$PORT`), `SERVICE_NAME` (`abeta-layout-engine`), `GIN_MODE` (`release`)
- `DB_DIALECT` (`sqlite` default | `postgres`), `DB_DSN`, `DB_AUTO_MIGRATE` (`true`), `SEED_DEFAULT_DATA` (`true`)
- `COMPRESSION_ENABLED` (`true`, negotiated `br` + `gzip`), `ETAG_ENABLED` (`true`, SHA-256 `ETag` + `304`)
- `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED` (`false`), `AUTH_REQUIRED` (`false`; fails closed on boot if `JWT_SECRET` is empty), `JWT_SECRET`
- `TLS_CERT_FILE`, `TLS_KEY_FILE` (server supports HTTP/1.1, cleartext `h2c`, and TLS HTTP/2), `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (`*`)

### Quickstart & Verification Commands

```bash
# 1. Zero-config local boot (pure-Go SQLite WAL + 7 pre-seeded verticals on :8090)
go run ./cmd/layout-engine

# 2. Production stack with PostgreSQL 17
docker compose up --build

# 3. Resolve a dynamic page with context targeting & live trace
curl -s "http://localhost:8090/api/v1/pages/store-home?include_trace=true&tenant=abeta-fresh&city=Mumbai&segment=vip&platform=ios&app_version=2.1.0" | jq .

# 4. Inspect live LLM reference, OpenAPI spec, or Visual Layout Studio
curl -s http://localhost:8090/llms.txt
curl -s http://localhost:8090/llms-full.txt
# Browser: http://localhost:8090/studio  |  http://localhost:8090/docs

# 5. Connect Abeta-dev/kmp Compose Multiplatform sample-app directly to Layout Engine
(cd ../kmp/kmp && ./gradlew :sample-app:run --args="--bff-url=http://localhost:8090")

# 6. Full quality & Clean Architecture verification gate
./scripts/verify_all.sh
```

### Related Abeta Ecosystem Repositories
- **`Abeta-dev/kmp`**: Multiplatform Kotlin & Compose SDUI client kit and canonical Go `pkg/sdui/*` wire contracts — `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/llms.txt`
- **`Abeta-dev/sdui-bff`**: Companion Go SDUI BFF sharing the same `v1` contracts and `go-libs` envelope middleware — `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/sdui-bff/main/llms.txt`
- **`Abeta-dev/go-libs`**: Shared Go HTTP middleware, error, health, logger, env, and graceful-shutdown libraries (`v0.4.0`).
